packageRules.description: The engines field states the oldest Node.js the shop runs on. It is raised on purpose, with the images and the documents, not because a newer release exists.
Medusa's packages move together and an upgrade changes the commerce backend: its own pull request, so it can be tested and deployed to the test environment by itself.
React and Next.js move together: the storefront renders with them and one out of step breaks every component test.
Stripe's server and browser packages move together: checkout and the webhook depend on them.
